ledger: skateboard | intact black deck with two silver trucks and four white wheels under skater's feet at 00:00 | deformed/split into two separate small fragments under skater's feet at 00:09 | popped into air at 00:01-00:02; front half vanishes on landing at 00:03 and reforms at 00:04; popped into air at 00:08 where one truck vanishes, then splits into two disconnected pieces at 00:09

findings.description: As the skater lands the first trick, the front half of the skateboard under his left foot disappears, then spontaneously reappears intact by 00:04.

While the skateboard is mid-air during the second jump, the left truck and wheels vanish completely from the underside of the deck, and upon landing at 00:09 the deck morphs into two separate, tiny fragments.
